name: GREEN×EXPO 2027 Yokohama
job: Help visitors choose the applicable ticket age reference, compare published day and pass prices, and understand separate admission and transport reservations.
source_notes: Official organiser lists 19 March–26 September, Kamiseya Yokohama. Published ticket age is as of 1 April 2026 for March visits and 1 April 2027 otherwise. Advance day, regular day, season and summer products have distinct terms; check current availability and booking.
